**The ninth release candidate.** It needs [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.8](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.8) or newer: update HMG-API first.

## What's new since 2.2.0-rc.8

- **An iPhone can be picked again after an Android phone** (#91): rc.8 remembered the last phone used for projection and refused every other one, even after that phone was removed from the car, so the iPhone never got a CarPlay icon in Device Connections. rc.8's park-and-leave ending, "chosen phone" and reconnect retries are taken back for now (#94); they'll come back after 1.1.0, once they've been tried with home Wi-Fi.
- **HMG-API brings up the Wi-Fi network** CarPlay and Android Auto join (`"wifi": {"projection": true}`), from boot and after QuickBoot. Android Auto gets it too, on cars whose own apps never start it (the US Sorento Plug-in Hybrid, HMG-API #314). Before each CarPlay attach, the mod asks HMG-API for it again instead of starting it itself (#93).

## What to test

- **An iPhone and an Android phone on one car:** after using Android Auto, the iPhone shows a CarPlay icon in Device Connections and connects.
- **Wireless Android Auto on a car where it never connected** (US Sorento Plug-in Hybrid and other 260507 Kias).
- **After a cold start, and after switching the car off and on a few minutes later:** CarPlay and Android Auto still connect.

## Known issues

- Wireless no longer ends by itself when you park and leave (rc.8's setting is gone with #94).
- The cluster's route-guidance watchdog (#51) and the Bluetooth Audio focus fix (#56) are unchanged.
